title: Kimning narsasi ekanini aytasiz: my, your, his, her
can_do: Egalilik ulmoshlarini to'g'ri ishlatasiz: my, your, his, her
why: Ingliz tilida egalilik — bu narsaning egalasini ko'rsatish: my bag — mening sumkamm, his key — uning kaliti. Shunday qilib, egalik ulmoshlarini tanlash kerak. Shunday qilib, shunday yodlang.

rule.title: Egalilik ulmoshlari: my, your, his, her

points.text: Ingliz tilida egalilik ulmoshlari: my — menga, your — sizning (siz), his — uning (og'a), her — uning (ayol). Shunday qilib, egalik ulmoshlarini tanlash kerak.
His — og'a egalik, her — ayol egalik. Bundan keyin, shunday qilib, shunday yodlang. Shunday qilib, shunday yodlang.

examples.en: His is my brother — U menga akam (og'a)
examples.uz: His is my brother — U menga akam (og'a)

examples.en: Her is my sister — U menga opam (ayol)
examples.uz: Her is my sister — U menga opam (ayol)

items.focus: egalik ulmoshlarini tanlash: my/emas, your/emas, his/emas, her/emas
egalik ulmosh bilan gap tuzish: his friend — her friend — my mother — your father

tarjima: «Mening akam» — His brother (og'a) — yoki My brother? shunday qilib emas — shunday yodlang — «O'z oilangizning odamlarining egalik ulmoshlarini yozing: shunday yodlang — shunday yodlang — «O'z oilangizning egalik ulmoshlarini yozing» — shunday yodlang. Shu sababni yodlang.

final.task: O'z oilangizdagi 4 odam haqida 4 ta gap yozing: my mother, your father, his brother, her sister — shunday yodlang.

skill_task.task: O'quvchi egalik ulmoshlashishni tinglab, ulmosh shaklini yozing: my bag — your bag — his bag — her bag. Shundan so'ng, shunday qilib, egalik ulmoshlarini yozing: shunday yodlang.
